recipes.name: Pan-Toasted Atta Jaggery Nankhatai
recipes.target_craving: Sweet biscuit or cookie craving
recipes.instructions: Mix 4 tbsp atta with 1 tbsp melted ghee and 1.5 tbsp jaggery powder. Shape into 2-3 small cookies and toast on low flame on a covered tawa for 4-5 mins per side until crisp.
recipes.why_better: Zero palm oil, 100% whole wheat with natural fiber, zero white refined sugar or artificial invert syrup.

recipes.name: Cacao Roasted Makhana Crunch
recipes.target_craving: Chocolate bar or sweet crispy treat
recipes.instructions: Dry roast 1 cup makhana in 1/2 tsp ghee until crunchy. Melt 2 cubes dark chocolate with 1 tsp warm milk, toss makhana in the glaze and let cool for 2 minutes.
recipes.why_better: Rich in magnesium and antioxidants; low glycemic load compared to ultra-processed candy bars filled with hydrogenated vegetable fats.

recipes.name: Quick Cinnamon Banana Pancake
recipes.target_craving: Cake, pastry or sweet bakery craving
recipes.instructions: Mash 1 ripe banana, whisk in 1 egg, 2 tbsp atta, and a pinch of cinnamon. Pour onto a lightly greased pan and cook 2 minutes each side until golden.
recipes.why_better: Natural sweetness from fruit, 7g bioavailable protein from real egg, zero high-fructose corn syrup or emulsifiers.

recipes.name: Spiced Roasted Chana Crunch
recipes.target_craving: Fried chips, bhujia or crunchy namkeen craving
recipes.instructions: Warm roasted chana in a pan with 3-4 drops mustard oil, sprinkle chaat masala, roasted jeera, and dry mango powder. Toss for 1 minute.
recipes.why_better: 19g protein & 15g fiber per 100g, 95% less fat than deep-fried palmolein bhujia, zero TBHQ chemical antioxidant (INS 319).

recipes.name: Tawa Roasted Poha Chivda
recipes.target_craving: Mixture, namkeen or potato chips craving
recipes.instructions: Dry roast thin poha on a wide tawa until crisp. In 1 tsp oil, splutter mustard seeds, curry leaves, green chilies, and peanuts with turmeric. Toss poha together with salt.
recipes.why_better: Light and easy to digest; uses fresh peanuts and heart-healthy home oil instead of repeatedly heated industrial palm oil.

recipes.name: Desi Masala Egg Toast
recipes.target_craving: Savory fried snack or instant noodles craving
recipes.instructions: Sauté chopped onion, tomato, and green chili for 2 minutes. Whisk in 2 eggs with salt and turmeric, scramble softly, and serve over toasted atta bread.
recipes.why_better: 14g high-biological-value protein and essential choline. Satiating meal that stops snack binging.

recipes.name: Desi Shikanji Sparkling Soda
recipes.target_craving: Cold fizzy soda or cola craving
hero_ingredients: Plain Sparkling Soda or Chilled Water
recipes.instructions: Squeeze half a fresh lemon into a glass, add a pinch of kala namak, roasted jeera powder, and 1 tsp raw sweetener. Pour chilled plain club soda over it.
recipes.why_better: Only ~4g natural sugar vs 35g refined sugar in commercial cola. Rich in natural Vitamin C and electrolytes with zero phosphoric acid or caramel colour.

recipes.name: Chilled Mint & Jeera Chaas
recipes.target_craving: Fizzy drink or canned beverage craving
recipes.instructions: Blend 1/2 cup fresh dahi with 1 cup cold water, fresh mint leaves, roasted jeera, and black salt for 30 seconds until frothy.
recipes.why_better: Natural gut probiotics, natural cooling hydration, zero added sugar, zero artificial preservatives.

recipes.name: Fiber-Rich Orange & Mint Slush
recipes.target_craving: Packaged fruit juice or mango drink craving
recipes.instructions: Peel whole orange, deseed, and blend directly with fresh mint leaves, ice cubes, and a pinch of black salt. DO NOT strain the pulp.
recipes.why_better: Keeps the natural citrus pectin and soluble fiber intact, preventing the rapid insulin spike caused by strained commercial fruit drinks.

recipes.name: Fresh Watermelon Lime Cooler
recipes.target_craving: Sweet packaged juice or nectar
recipes.instructions: Blend chilled watermelon cubes with a squeeze of fresh lime and a pinch of chaat masala. Serve immediately unstrained.
recipes.why_better: 100% natural fruit hydration, zero high-fructose corn syrup, rich in natural lycopene and potassium.

recipes.name: Bihari Chana Sattu Protein Cooler
recipes.target_craving: Protein bar or packaged protein shake craving
recipes.instructions: Whisk 3 heaped tablespoons of sattu into 250ml chilled chaas or water with lemon juice, roasted jeera, and black salt until smooth.
recipes.why_better: Provides 10g clean whole-food plant protein, insoluble fiber, and magnesium for only ₹10, with zero artificial sucralose or thickeners.

recipes.name: Pan-Seared Kasuri Methi Paneer
recipes.target_craving: High protein processed snack or nuggets
recipes.instructions: Cut paneer into cubes, dust with chaat masala, pepper, and crushed kasuri methi. Sear in 1/2 tsp warm ghee on a hot tawa for 2 minutes.
recipes.why_better: 18g intact casein and whey protein with bioavailable calcium; zero soy protein isolates or cheap vegetable fat extenders.

recipes.name: Street-Style Boiled Egg Chaat
recipes.target_craving: High protein snack craving
recipes.instructions: Slice 2 boiled eggs into rounds, top with chopped onion, tomato, fresh green chutney, chaat masala, and a squeeze of lemon.
recipes.why_better: 12g complete protein with all 9 essential amino acids and vitamin B12 for ₹14, beating ₹100+ ultra-processed protein cookies.

recipes.name: Quick Black Pepper Chicken Toss
recipes.target_craving: Protein bar, chicken nuggets, or jerky
recipes.instructions: Cut chicken breast into thin bite-sized strips. Sauté minced garlic and curry leaves in 1/2 tsp oil, add chicken strips and crushed pepper. Cook on high heat for 6-7 minutes. Finish with lemon.
recipes.why_better: 31g lean whole-food protein with near-zero carbs and zero chemical preservatives for ~₹40.

recipes.name: Crispy Besan & Greens Cheela
recipes.target_craving: White bread, instant noodles, or refined biscuits
recipes.instructions: Mix 1/2 cup besan with water, crushed ajwain, turmeric, salt, and chopped greens to make a smooth pouring batter. Pour onto hot cast-iron tawa and cook both sides until crisp.
recipes.why_better: Low glycemic index, rich in dietary fiber and plant protein, 0% refined maida or bleached wheat.

recipes.name: Whole Wheat Kathi Egg Roll
recipes.target_craving: Packaged burger, instant noodles, or wrap
recipes.instructions: Beat 1 egg with salt and pour onto hot tawa; immediately press a cooked whole wheat roti on top. Flip once cooked, add sliced onions and mint chutney, and roll up.
recipes.why_better: Nutritious balanced meal with complex carbs and protein; avoids the hydrogenated shortening and refined flour of commercial bakery wraps.

recipes.name: Charred Tomato Garlic Chutney
recipes.target_craving: Bottled tomato ketchup or synthetic dipping sauce
recipes.instructions: Roast whole tomatoes and garlic cloves directly on an open flame until the skins blister and char. Peel slightly, mash with chopped green chili, salt, and raw mustard oil.
recipes.why_better: Commercial ketchup is 25-30% pure sugar; this homemade version has zero added sugar, high cooked lycopene, and robust fresh flavor.

recipes.name: Fresh Mint-Coriander Dahi Dip
recipes.target_craving: Bottled mayonnaise, cheese dip, or processed dressings
recipes.instructions: Blend fresh mint, coriander, garlic, and green chili with 1 tbsp water. Stir into 1/2 cup thick fresh curd with rock salt and roasted cumin.
recipes.why_better: Commercial mayo is 70% refined soybean oil and water; this dip provides live probiotics, calcium, and fresh plant polyphenols.

recipes.name: Golden Turmeric Milk with Crushed Almonds
recipes.target_craving: Flavored milk, milkshakes, or sweet malt drinks
recipes.instructions: Warm milk with 1/4 tsp turmeric, a pinch of black pepper (enhances curcumin absorption by 2000%), crushed elaichi, and sliced almonds.
recipes.why_better: Avoids the 20g+ added sugar and maltodextrin found in branded malt health drinks; natural anti-inflammatory benefits.

recipes.name: Cardamom Spiced Sweet Lassi
recipes.target_craving: Commercial sweet curd, milkshake, or ice cream
recipes.instructions: Churn fresh thick curd with cold water, 1 tsp natural sweetener, and freshly ground cardamom until frothy. Garnish with crushed pista.
recipes.why_better: Real active bacterial cultures; zero artificial vanilla essence or synthetic milk fat replacers.

recipes.name: Street-Style Warm Masala Corn
recipes.target_craving: Packaged popcorn, nachos, or savory processed snacks
recipes.instructions: Steam sweet corn kernels for 3-4 minutes. Toss while steaming hot with 1/2 tsp butter, fresh lime juice, chaat masala, and chopped coriander.
recipes.why_better: Intact dietary fiber and natural carotenoids without industrial hydrogenated trans fats or synthetic cheese flavor powders.

recipes.name: Pan-Fried Egg over Sautéed Garlic Greens
recipes.target_craving: Quick processed meal or instant snack
recipes.instructions: Quickly toss sliced garlic and spinach in 1/2 tsp ghee for 1 minute until wilted. Crack 1 egg right on top, cover pan for 2-3 minutes until whites set.
recipes.why_better: High nutrient density with lutein, iron, and complete protein in 6 minutes, eliminating the need for preserved foods.
